1_notebook_library_and_companion_card_de.mechanism: Updated `GEMINI_TASK.md` and `QA_WORKFLOW.md` so YouTube URLs are registered as Notebook sources (for primary-source transcript reference inside Notebook without copying transcripts to GitHub) alongside a structured companion study card (`動画研究カード_<video_id>`) containing chapter table of contents, verified timestamps, clickable YouTube deep links, and related research, while strictly protecting existing Notebook sources and `AI技術研究室_知識索引.md`.

2_github_rich_research_records_and_backw.mechanism: Upgraded `contract_spec_v1.json` to `gemini_notebook_bridge_contract_v1_6` while keeping 100% backward compatibility with `research_receipt_v1`. Added optional `detailed_findings_ja` (up to 2,500 chars / 25 newlines of structured analysis, still protected by `scan_forbidden_keys` against secret tokens and verbatim SRT/transcript dumps), `chapters` (up to 25 chapter segments with `start_seconds`, `end_seconds`, `summary_ja`, `timestamp_source`, `key_topics`), `related_records` (`EXTENDS`, `UPDATES`, `COMPLEMENTS`, `CONTRADICTS`, `RESOLVES_BACKLOG`), and `claims[].timestamp_source`.

3_strict_timestamp_reliability_and_prove.mechanism: Every chapter and claim timestamp records `timestamp_source` (`YOUTUBE_CHAPTER_METADATA`, `TIMESTAMPED_CAPTIONS`, `VISUAL_FRAME_CHECK`, `OFFICIAL_TIME_RANGE`, `UNKNOWN`). Validation in both Python and GAS rejects any numeric `start_seconds`/`timestamp_seconds` when `timestamp_source == 'UNKNOWN'` and rejects missing `start_seconds` when `timestamp_source != 'UNKNOWN'`. Rendering and search generate clickable `&t=XXs` YouTube links ONLY when `start_seconds` is a verified integer and `timestamp_source != 'UNKNOWN'`.

4_natural_language_qa_and_timestamped_vi.mechanism: Implemented `automation/gemini-notebook/query_research.py` and generated `automation/gemini-notebook/state/video_knowledge_catalog.json`. Executes the 6-step pipeline: (1) query intent & synonym analysis (`CONCEPT_AND_BASICS`, `FAILURE_AND_LIMITS`, `IMPLEMENTATION_AND_HOWTO`, `VERIFICATION_AND_OFFICIAL_SPEC`, `VIDEO_LOCATOR`), (2) purpose-weighted + verification-weighted search across GitHub records/chapters/claims, (3) Gemini Notebook deep-source lookup recommendation, (4) knowledge gap detection & follow-up discovery query suggestion, (5) evidence-backed answer synthesis, and (6) verified YouTube deep-link (`&t=XXs`) table output.

verified_cases.evidence: Verified 100% Python/GAS output parity on v0.6 rich receipts (`chapters`, `detailed_findings_ja`, `related_records`, `timestamp_source`), rejection of fabricated timestamps on `UNKNOWN` source, and end-to-end natural-language Q&A + verified `&t=XXs` segment ranking and gap detection via `query_research.py`.
